title: Gauge: min/max range labels

complexity.rationale: Pure static text placed at the arc's two existing endpoint angles, using values and geometry that already exist on Gauge - no new signals, scales, or design decisions.

summary: Adds an optional showRangeLabels flag to Gauge that displays the scale's minimum and maximum values as text at the two ends of the arc.
requirements: Accept a showRangeLabels boolean, default false.
When true, display minScaleValue as text at the arc's start end and maxScaleValue as text at the arc's end end.
Range labels render outside the arc's outer edge and do not overlap the track, needle, fill, ticks, or center text.

edgeCases.case: minScaleValue or maxScaleValue has many digits
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: truncate with an ellipsis rather than overlapping neighboring content
label font size scales down proportionally with the rendered arc, consistent with the existing center value/label text
label color remains a fixed neutral token legible against both

implementationPlan.change: Add a showRangeLabels boolean field (with a default) to the public Gauge contract.
When showRangeLabels is true, render minScaleValue and maxScaleValue as text at the arc's two endpoint angles.
Expose showRangeLabels on the public GaugeProps.
Add a story with range labels enabled.

openQuestions: planning/specs/schema.json's chartType enum has no 'gauge' value; this spec uses the 'chart' fallback until 'gauge' is added (ideally to the pre-alpha list), at which point this file should move to planning/specs/pre-alpha/gauge/.
